children: Chinese companies are likely to continue to adopt humanoid robots in the long run, Morgan Stanley says in a note. Citing a recent survey the U.S. bank did with corporate executives in China, the bank says their willingness remains high for adoption. "While there is a delay in deployment timeline, corporates are increasingly focused on validation before deployment, adopting a more pragmatic approach to commercialization," Morgan Stanley says. The bank names leading component suppliers as early beneficiaries, including Leader Harmonious Drive Systems, Zhejiang Shuanghuan Driveline and Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
